sanskrit_verse: बाधां कुर्युर् यद् एकस्य संभूता द्वेषसंयुताः ।। Brh_1,17.19 ।।
transliteration: bādhāṃ kuryur yad ekasya saṃbhūtā dveṣasaṃyutāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: When two parties arise in conflict due to mutual hatred born from the same source, both bear equal responsibility for the obstruction caused.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from unity; division arises from misaligned consciousness.
Causation is rooted in internal disharmony manifesting externally.
Capacity-based responsibility applies equally where intent and action stem from shared negativity.
Restoration logic demands recognition of common origin before resolution.
Consciousness alignment requires dissolution of dualistic opposition.
executable_legal_axioms: IF two parties claim adversarial status due to a shared causal root THEN assign equal causal weight to each party's contribution.
IF mutual hatred is identified as cause THEN initiate simultaneous restoration protocols for all involved parties.
IF obstruction results from internal disunity THEN realign consciousness prior to determining liability.
IF no singular initiating actor exists THEN treat all reactive actors as co-originators of consequence.
supreme_court_application: In cases involving reciprocal enmity causing systemic harm, the Supreme Court must recognize the non-linear causality inherent in mutual antagonism and refrain from assigning unilateral fault. Judgment shall focus on restoring unified consciousness rather than attributing blame.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that duality emerges from undifferentiated consciousness; hence, both actors are epistemologically equivalent. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that hatred ripens simultaneously in both. Therefore, proportional responsibility is neutralized by shared origination. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering cannot resolve what originated in ignorance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate joint completion process until shared resentment is acknowledged.
Deploy mirrored reflection protocol to reveal identical patterns in both parties.
Enforce silence period for emotional detoxification before dialogue resumes.
Assign collaborative task requiring mutual dependence to rebuild relational integrity.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Conflict born of shared aversion reflects distortion, not difference. Resolution lies in returning to source-consciousness. There is no punishment—only awakening. Dharma is restored. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
